verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a no-cost Free Edition workspace for experimenting (it replaces Community Edition), which serves as a free sandbox. Databricks Connect and dbt Core let engineers write and debug code in a local IDE, but that code still runs on Databricks compute rather than a local engine. Free Edition is positioned for learning and hobbyists, not as a dev tier tied to production pipelines. Missing for 10: a local engine or emulator for offline transformation development, a documented promotion path from the free sandbox to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of dev-loop speed.
